lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Now, this here is a rubber boot, cut clean out of an old poster.
lines.caption: A rubber boot, cut out of an old Boston Rubber Shoe Co. poster.

lines.speaker: turkey
lines.text: Well, I'll be. Is that a shipwreck? A giant's foot? Or some kinda tunnel?
lines.caption: Turkey: Shipwreck? Giant's foot? Or a tunnel?

lines.speaker: trout
lines.text: Lord have mercy! Is that boot sole a flashlight? Or is a crab a-bitin' its toe?
lines.caption: Trout: Is its sole a torch, or is a crab biting its toe?
